subject: Film & Cinema
title: Slasher Films: Fear on a Budget
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Slasher Films: Fear on a Budget.

hook.text: Halloween cost $325,000 in 1978 and earned $70 million. Studios took notice.

buildup.text: Slashers followed a formula: a masked killer, a group of victims, and a final girl.

discovery.text: The 'final girl' trope gave horror its first feminist archetype — the survivor.

twist.text: Scream later deconstructed the genre by making characters aware of slasher rules.

climax.text: Slashers proved horror could be massively profitable with minimal investment.

punchline.text: Fear is the cheapest special effect.

quiz.question: What is the 'final girl' trope in slasher films?
options: The last surviving female character who defeats the killer
